text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer. Starting this 
year, the Classic season is finally 
here...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, today's New Year's Day, isn't 
it?! Isn't this room way too bare?!
choice_data_list: It's the same as always, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying acting like everything's normal 
is what's weird! You total klutz!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Honestly, just wait a second...!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King~, is this window decoration okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, perfect! You girls really did it♪
choice_data_list: So this is the work of a master...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho, praise me more♪ I'd expect 
nothing less from a junior of the King!
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! Looks like the osechi we ordered just 
arrived! Hold on everyone, wait right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah. No, thank *you* so much! For letting 
me spend New Year's with King again this 
year.
choice_data_list:
Are you two always together, even on New 
Year's?

Are you two always together, even on New 
Year's?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, we're the group staying behind for 
the holidays~.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Things are a bit rough between me and 
my family. Ever since I came here, I've 
just holed up in my room every New Year's 
and Obon.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ever since King first arrived, though—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I heard there was a pair of 
underclassmen spending an utterly plain 
New Year's here!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-Who's there!? Barging into my room out 
of nowhere! Even if you are a senior, 
that's no excuse—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, could you stop calling me just 
'senpai'? I am a first-class horse girl, 
King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And be grateful! I shall teach you how a 
first-class New Year's is spent!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You two! I shall grant you the privilege 
of making mochi with me! Come along!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Senpai, that thing over there is 
just a regular rice cooker... right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Mochi is just rolled-up rice, 
right? So if you squeeze it tight in your 
hands—

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpaiii... That's just a plain old rice 
ball thennn...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aah, no fair! Both of you snuggling up in 
the kotatsu together!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, squeeze together more! Make room 
for the King! Or else I'm confiscating the 
mandarins!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ehh, that's so mean, Senpai~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Not "Senpai"—call me King!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...It's so fun being with King. She's 
always full of confidence and so bright."

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"So, we decided~ To give back for all the 
happy moments she's given us, we're gonna 
do our best to help King this year~."

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Because this year is the most important 
year for making King's goals come true~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the osechi has arrived! Come, 
let us devise our plans for this year 
while we feast!
choice_data_list: Let's make this an important year.
Let's make this a meaningful year.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? What is it now? Making that face 
won't stop me from billing you for your 
share later, you know?

And then, everyone enjoyed the osechi 
meant for four...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was simply delicious... I 
really must praise past-me for making that 
reservation six months ago...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then... let's talk about what comes 
next.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even with the turn of the new year, my 
policy remains unchanged. "Pursue the 
Triple Crown route." And then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll make her acknowledge me. You know 
what to do, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fine then. Let us put it into action 
starting today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a "first-class Trainer," how do you 
plan to raise this "first-class 
Umamusume"?
choice_data_list:
First, become an Umamusume who doesn't 
gain New Year weight.
Become an Uma Musume who values rest.
Become an Umamusume loved by all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you really one to talk?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You say that after eating just as much 
osechi as a growing Umamusume in her 
prime?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let me see your tummy! Compared 
to the flawless King, isn't yours bulging 
out a bit, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? King, no! Trainer's stomach! 
Eeek!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Since we have the chance, I shall 
whip your daily lifestyle right back into 
shape!

"...And thus, right from New Year's Day, I 
ended up being the one getting lectured by 
King Halo."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you saying something 
surprisingly sensible.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Falling ill right before an 
important event is out of the question. I 
must be perfect at all times.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Especially now that it's winter. Catching 
a cold is out of the question. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Should we secure some Vitamin C for now? 
...Want to eat a mandarin orange or 
something?

And while eating mikan for dessert, I 
relaxed and thoroughly enjoyed New Year's.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You can't make that your goal!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I mean, King, you're already an Umamusume 
who's beloved by everyone, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's with that look? Trainer, 
what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Care to explain this to me? Briefly, and 
just the key points, if you will.

And so, I was subjected to King Halo's 
interrogation for quite a while after 
that...
